links.comparator_used: OpenAI GPT-5.1 general-purpose model answering without retrieval (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Undertriage rate on the ordered MTS scale across 156 prompts per system
links.effect: GPT-5.1 undertriaged 44.2% (69/156; 95% CI 36.7 to 52.1), including 75.0% of Red and 73.4% of Orange prompts. Both DR. INFO configurations undertriaged 11.5% (18/156; 95% CI 7.4 to 17.5), Fisher's exact p = 1.0e-10. With the misleading GP anchoring statement, GPT-5.1 undertriaged 8/8 Red prompts and DR. INFO undertriaged none.
links.quote: On this benchmark, replacing a general purpose language model with an agentic retrieval augmented system over a curated clinical knowledge base substantially reduced the undertriage rate.

links.comparator_used: Same prompts without the objective clinical data block (vital signs, examination findings, laboratory results)
links.outcome: Undertriage rate with versus without the objective clinical data block
links.effect: Undertriage in DR. INFO with MTS retrieval fell from 19.2% to 3.8% (p = 0.005). DR. INFO Baseline and GPT-5.1 showed no comparable change.
links.quote: Of the three configurations evaluated here, DR. INFO with MTS retrieval combined a clinically conservative assignment at Red priority with a reduction in undertriage when objective clinical data were added (19.2% to 3.8%).

design_hint: retrieval-augmented generation grounding on clinical guidelines and anchoring bias stress-testing
